description: This file defines an abstract class 'NotificationPreset' used as a base for notification preset generators in an Android Wearable notifications project. It includes nested classes, fields, constructors, and abstract methods related to building notification presets.

classes.name: NotificationPreset
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a base for notification preset generators, providing common properties and methods for building notifications.

classes.name: NotificationPreset.BuildOptions
classes.description: Inner static class encapsulating options for building notifications, such as titles, priorities, actions, and other configurations.

methods.name: NotificationPreset
methods.description: Constructor initializing title and text resource IDs.

methods.name: buildNotifications
methods.description: Abstract method to build an array of notifications based on context and build options.

methods.name: actionsRequired
methods.description: Method indicating whether actions are required for the preset (default false).

methods.name: countBackgroundPickersRequired
methods.description: Method returning the number of background pickers needed (default 0).
